### Main questions

We want to find the mutation statistics for Ben's samples

### 1.0 Package requirements

- Include required packages 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("stringr")
require("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38")

```

- change to current working directory `/export2/home/koustav/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/`.


- Set paths

```{r}

setwd("/export2/home/koustav/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/")
analysis_path <- "18-screening-for-erap2-mutations-in-postmortem"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")
output_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "output_files")

dir.create(save_dir)
dir.create(plot_dir)
dir.create(input_dir)
dir.create(output_dir)

```

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Import the list of SNPs and filter for those that are within the ERAP2 gene body

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

mutation_df <- data.table::fread(file.path(input_dir, "snp_result.txt"), data.table = F)
erap2_location_df <- data.frame(chr = 5, start = 96875984, end = 96919716)
mutation_df <- mutation_df[mutation_df$pos >= erap2_location_df$start & mutation_df$pos <= erap2_location_df$end,]

```

- Fetch all alt alleles

```{r}

    hg38 <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38
    all_mutation_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(mutation_df)), function(x){
        message(x)
        all_alleles <- str_split(string = mutation_df$variation[x], 
            pattern = ">", simplify = T)
        ref_allele <- all_alleles[1,1]
        alt_alleles <- all_alleles[1,2]
        if(grepl(x = all_alleles[1,2], pattern = ",")){
            alt_alleles <- str_split(string = all_alleles[1,2], 
            pattern = ",", simplify = T)[1,]
        }
        # alt_allele_vector <- unique(str_split(string = 
        #     do.call(c, str_split(string = mutation_df$frequency[x], 
        #     pattern = "\\|", simplify = F)), pattern = ":", simplify = T)[,1])
        # fetch_left_seq <- getSeq(hg38, names = paste("chr", mutation_df[x,"#chr"], sep = ""), 
        #     start = as.numeric(mutation_df$pos[x]) - 10,
        #     end = as.numeric(mutation_df$pos[x]) - 1)
        #fetch_left_seq_neg <- getSeq(hg38, names = paste("chr", mutation_df[x,"#chr"], sep = ""), 
        #    start = as.numeric(mutation_df$pos[x]) - 10,
        #    end = as.numeric(mutation_df$pos[x]) - 1)
        # fetch_right_seq <- getSeq(hg38, names = paste("chr", mutation_df[x,"#chr"], sep = ""), 
        #     start = as.numeric(mutation_df$pos[x]) + 1,
        #     end = as.numeric(mutation_df$pos[x]) + 10)
        return_mutation_df <- data.frame(chromosome = mapSeqlevels(paste("chr",mutation_df[x,"#chr"], sep = ""), "ENSEMBL"), 
            pos = mutation_df[x,"pos"],
            reference = ref_allele, 
            alternative = alt_alleles)
        return(return_mutation_df)
    }))
    write.table(x = all_mutation_df[all_mutation_df$alternative != "_",], 
        file = file.path(input_dir, "01-list-of-mutations.txt"),
        sep = "\t",
        quote = F,
        col.names = F,
        row.names = F)

```
